title: 1,300 Years Ago This Was Chang'an — Wear the Tang Robes or Not? | China Travel Expert
description:
Roll into Xi'an and it looks like any big Chinese city — until you remember what it used to be.

Thirteen hundred years ago this was Chang'an, the capital of the Tang dynasty and one of the largest cities on earth. Today its old streets near the Bell Tower and Muslim Quarter are packed with studios renting Tang-style hanfu robes for photo shoots — a whole tourist ritual built on the city's history.

🧭 Expert Tip: book the hanfu shoot for a weekday morning. Weekends and holidays turn the popular streets into a slow-moving scrum, and the good photo spots get crowded fast.

西安，一千三百年前的大唐长安。如今钟楼、回民街一带的老街满是汉服写真店——把历史穿在身上拍照。
